rationale: The Evaluator feedback suggests increasing the base_speed from 1.2 to 1.5 to meet the target average speed of about 1.5 m/s needed to complete the course in under 3 seconds. This should improve the pace and likelihood of completion. The integral gain ki is reduced from 0.5 to 0.2 to reduce potential overshoot and oscillations, which can destabilize the robot's steering. Sensor weights are adjusted to [-2, -1, 0, 1, 2] to increase the magnitude on the outer sensors, enhancing sensitivity to line position and improving steering precision. The rest of the geometry and controller parameters remain unchanged to preserve the balanced design. I expect these changes to increase speed and stability, reduce oscillations, and improve line tracking, leading to better completion rates and lower line loss events. I request telemetry measurements including completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, line_loss_events, and steering_oscillation to verify these hypotheses.
